title: Governance Invariant Definition
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected definition of an AGCP governance invariant. DS-008 preserves source specification and governance lineage, deterministic invariant semantics, protected or constitutional classification, enforcement level, Governance Configuration binding, compilation and validation evidence, Governance Version, Controlled Governance Activation, and explicit non-weakening semantics without itself establishing authority at commitment, determining Commit-Bound Admissibility, authorizing execution, activating governance, or committing a transition.

invariant_type_registry_ref.description: Reference to the authoritative invariant-type registry release used to interpret invariant_type.

invariant_definition_id.description: Stable DS-008 Governance Invariant Definition identifier.

invariant_type.description: Invariant type registered in the applicable invariant-type registry.

invariant_scope_classification.description: Architectural scope at which the invariant must remain true.

invariant_enforcement_level.description: Hard invariant failure prevents the governed operation or artifact from progressing; Soft invariant failure is recorded and handled only through explicit governance policy.

invariant_definition_ref.description: Integrity-bound reference to a DS-008 Governance Invariant Definition.

invariant_effective_scope.description: Scope in which the invariant must remain satisfied.

invariant_source_representation.description: Canonical source representation of the invariant before Governance Compilation.

invariant_semantics.description: Deterministic, implementation-independent semantics used to evaluate the invariant.

compilation_projection.description: Integrity-bound projection of the authoritative DS-042 compilation and validation record. This projection does not replace DS-042.

namespaced_extensions.description: Namespaced non-normative extensions. Extensions cannot alter canonical invariant meaning.
